PRODUCTIVE OBSERVATION/DECISION -> OUTCOME / SYSTEM EVIDENCE -> SELF-LEARNING -> LEARNING EVIDENCE ->
OPTIMIZATION INPUT

6. Forecast Quality, Experiment Evidence and Anti-Overfit 
Market Intelligence and Optimization are only useful if their claims survive temporal and statistical validation. The same evidence
discipline must cover both forecasting and parameter research. 
Control   Required role
Point-in-time separation   Prevent future information entering features, labels, state or candidate evaluation.
Walk-forward   Measure stability through time rather than one train/test split.
Overlap control   Purging/embargo or equivalent where outcome horizons overlap.
Multiple-testing awareness   Record full search space and trial count, not only the winner.
Challenger / OOS   Separate discovery from evidence used for acceptance.
Monte Carlo / Stress   Test path, sampling and adverse-condition sensitivity.
Cost sensitivity   Prevent apparent robustness that disappears under plausible fees/slippage.
Regime/state stability   Measure whether evidence is conditional or broadly stable.
Calibration   Probability forecasts must match realized frequencies within evidence limits.
Coverage / abstention   Unsupported intelligence must be allowed to abstain.
Drift   Detect mismatch between current observations and evidence population. 
6.1 Experiment and Failure Memory 
Rejected hypotheses and failed experiments are first-class evidence. Persist search space, trial count, failure reasons,
walk-forward/stress/robustness failures and materially new evidence that justified a retry. Meta-Learning should reduce repeated
rediscovery of already rejected hypotheses. 
6.2 Counterfactual / shadow research 
Historical replay may compare observed outcomes with alternative allowed model or parameter hypotheses. This remains offline
research with COUNTERFACTUAL_AUTHORITY=NONE and cannot create a direct runtime decision path. "
